title: Paloma Rewards Goodwill Point Limits
content:
The goodwill points a support agent may grant to a Paloma Rewards member are limited per service-failure case and per trailing 12 months, at figures set by the member's tier.

| Tier | Most goodwill points for one service failure | Most goodwill points a member may receive in the trailing 12 months |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 250 | 750 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 250 | 750 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 500 | 1500 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 500 | 1500 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 1000 | 3000 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 1500 | 5000 |

## Reading the limits

- The first column limits a single grant; the second limits the total of goodwill points the member receives across the trailing 12 months.
- On every tier the 12-month figure is three times the per-case figure or more: 750 against 250, 1500 against 500, 3000 against 1000, and 5000 against 1500.
- Hypothetical illustration: on Paloma Rewards Gold a single grant can be no larger than 500 points, and a member who has received 1200 goodwill points in the trailing 12 months can receive at most 300 more.
